pwa.install: Install SGI Cloud on my device
pwa.iosSteps: In Safari, tap the Share button and then “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.genericSteps: Open the browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home Screen”. In Chrome and Edge you can also use the install icon in the address bar.

forgot.title: Request a password reset
forgot.intro: For security, passwords are not sent by email. Your request will reach your company administrator, who will give you a temporary password.
forgot.done: If the details are correct, your company administrator will receive the request. Contact them to receive your temporary password.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.forced: You must set a new password before continuing.
changePassword.rules: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers. It cannot contain your username or repeat your last 5 passwords.

areaDescriptions.documents: GMP document control: procedures, specifications and records with versions and electronic signatures.
areaDescriptions.quality: Deviations, CAPA, change control, complaints, OOS/OOT, batch release and product quality review.
areaDescriptions.metrology: Equipment, calibrations, reference standards, uncertainty, proficiency testing and reports (ISO/IEC 17025), qualifications and maintenance.
areaDescriptions.warehouse: Good Storage, Distribution and Transport Practices: environmental conditions, cold chain and recalls.
areaDescriptions.audits: Annual plan, GMP self-inspections, supplier audits and regulatory inspections.
areaDescriptions.system: Context, policy, risks, indicators and management review of the integrated system.
areaDescriptions.more: Training, suppliers and customers, products and marketing authorizations.
areaDescriptions.admin: Users, password requests, audit trail and company details.
areaDescriptions.hse: Environmental management (ISO 14001) and occupational health and safety (ISO 45001).

toolDescriptions.masterList: Inventory of all current documentation, with code, version, owner and review date.
toolDescriptions.sops: Standard operating procedures with drafting, review, approval and distribution workflow.
toolDescriptions.specifications: Specifications for raw materials, packaging materials and finished product.
toolDescriptions.records: Controlled forms and records, organized by process.
toolDescriptions.reviewInbox: Documents pending your review or approval.
toolDescriptions.mySignatures: History of your electronic signatures and their meaning.
toolDescriptions.deviations: Recording, classification, root cause investigation and closure of deviations.
toolDescriptions.capa: Corrective and preventive actions with follow-up and effectiveness check.
toolDescriptions.changeControl: Impact and risk assessment, approval and implementation of changes.
toolDescriptions.complaints: Receipt, investigation and response to customer product complaints.
toolDescriptions.oos: Investigation of out-of-specification and out-of-trend results.
toolDescriptions.batchRelease: Batch record review and release decision by Quality Assurance.
toolDescriptions.apqr: Periodic quality review of each product (APQR/PQR).
toolDescriptions.equipment: Inventory of equipment and instruments with status, location and criticality.
toolDescriptions.calibrations: Calibration program, certificates, standards, uncertainty and conformity.
toolDescriptions.qualifications: Installation, operational and performance qualification of equipment and areas.
toolDescriptions.storageAreas: Storage zones, locations and their sensors.
toolDescriptions.environment: Temperature and humidity records and trends by area.
toolDescriptions.excursions: Temperature excursion management and impact assessment.
toolDescriptions.receiving: Receipt of materials and products, quarantine and approval.
toolDescriptions.dispatch: Shipments, carriers and cold chain control.
toolDescriptions.returns: Assessment and disposition of returned products.
toolDescriptions.recalls: Real and mock market recalls with scope and recovery.
toolDescriptions.auditPlan: Annual planning of internal and external audits.
toolDescriptions.selfInspections: GMP self-inspections with checklist and scoring.
toolDescriptions.authorityInspections: Health authority inspections and their observations.
toolDescriptions.context: Internal and external issues, interested parties and their requirements.
toolDescriptions.policy: Quality policy, system scope and process map.
toolDescriptions.risks: Quality risk management (ICH Q9): probability, impact and residual risk.
toolDescriptions.indicators: Objectives, indicators, targets and periodic measurements.
toolDescriptions.managementReview: Inputs, decisions and actions of the management review.
toolDescriptions.training: Training plan, competence matrix and attendance records.
toolDescriptions.suppliers: Qualification of suppliers, carriers and authorized customers.
toolDescriptions.products: Products, marketing authorizations and their expiry dates.
toolDescriptions.users: Create, edit, suspend and reset passwords for users.
toolDescriptions.auditTrail: Who did what and when, with old and new values.
toolDescriptions.referenceStandards: Measurement standards and reference materials with their metrological traceability and validity.
toolDescriptions.uncertainty: Measurement uncertainty estimation and method validation or verification.
toolDescriptions.proficiency: Participation in proficiency tests and interlaboratory comparisons, with their evaluation.
toolDescriptions.labReports: Issue and control of test reports and calibration certificates.
toolDescriptions.envAspects: Identification and evaluation of significant environmental aspects by process.
toolDescriptions.legalRequirements: Applicable environmental and OHS legal requirements and compliance evaluation.
toolDescriptions.waste: Recording, classification and disposal of waste, including hazardous waste.
toolDescriptions.emergencies: Emergency response plans, drills and their results.
toolDescriptions.hazards: Hazard identification, risk assessment and determination of controls.
toolDescriptions.incidents: Reporting and investigation of work incidents and accidents.
toolDescriptions.ppe: Assignment, delivery and replacement of personal protective equipment.
toolDescriptions.participation: Worker consultation and participation in OHS management.
